description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller, `ShoppingCategoryRESTController`, providing web services for category management in an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints to retrieve, create, and delete category entities associated with merchant stores, utilizing various services and data populators.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryRESTController
classes.description: REST controller class handling category-related HTTP requests, including retrieval, creation, and deletion of categories linked to merchant stores.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a category by ID for a specific store, performing permission checks and returning a populated ReadableCategory object.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new category within a specific merchant store, populating and saving the category entity.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a category by ID from a specific merchant store.
